title: conversation-capabilities v1
description: What one agent harness's conversation adapter says it can do, as data: agents/<name>/conversation.json (relay design 2026-10-09, Q2 and PR plan item 9; conversations/Port.ps1). Each capability is declared in the vocabulary the host, transport, messenger and relay capability files use - yes, no, declined or unverified - with its evidence; unverified counts as no, and a yes needs evidence that was run (test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 demonstrates every yes it can). The list is closed: an adapter declares every one, and nothing else. Four are things a reader can rely on (incremental, stableTurnIds, timestamps, roles); two are HAZARDS a reader must cope with when they are anything but no (partialTurns, mutableHistory): a caller that cannot cope refuses an adapter for which they are not a plain no (Find-HordeConversationAdapter -Refuse), so an unverified hazard is treated as present.

incremental.description: A read resumes from the cursor of the last one and returns only what came after it, without reading the conversation again from its start.

stableTurnIds.description: turnId is the harness's own id for the item, the same however and whenever it is read. no: the adapter derives it from where the turn sits in its file (offset and content hash), which holds only while the file is never rewritten.

timestamps.description: Every turn carries the time the harness wrote it.

roles.description: What a person typed is told apart from what the model wrote, and from the harness's own text, by the harness's own marks - never by guessing from the words.

partialTurns.description: HAZARD. A turn already returned may come again later with more text (a response streamed into one record that grows). no: once returned, a turn's text never changes.

mutableHistory.description: HAZARD. The harness may edit, rewind or remove turns already written (an operation log, a file rewritten in place), so a turn already returned may be withdrawn. no: what was written stays written.

evidence.description: What was run or read, and when. Never blank.
